hypotheses.F0_factor_decomposition_recomposes: The five final-head QK/value factors recompose the dominant head residual with error <=1e-4 relative to the full exact response for every failure and control.
hypotheses.F1_one_factor_dominates: Across failures, the median largest absolute factor projection share is at least 0.50 and median effective factor support is at most 3.
hypotheses.F2_routing_derivative_dominates: The median absolute projection mass assigned to the four QK-routing factors is at least 0.80.
hypotheses.F3_direct_current_value_dominates: The median absolute projection share of the direct current-value derivative is at least 0.50.
